title: Went too far last time
html_source: Bloom suspects that his pen pal Martha hasn’t answered “Henry Flower’s” last letter because he “went too far last time.” So, Bloom sent a racy letter to Martha. In Chapter 18, Molly tells us that Bloom liked to write racy letters to her when they were dating. They turned Molly on and she had to pretend to not know what all the words meant. She wishes someone would write one like that to her now (Boylan’s letter was matter of fact and boring).
